property_summary: For any call sending 10 ether with a fresh timestamp, C pays out its entire balance exactly when the current block number is divisible by 15 (block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant only pays when block.number % 15 == 1, so at a fuzzed block number divisible by 15 the reference drains address(c).balance to 0 while the mutant leaves funds stuck.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 == 1, altering which blocks trigger the transfer.
